names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 8 aprilie, «Sfântul Apostol Ermis».
Read out of saint.gr's line for 8 Μαρτίου, «Άγιος Ερμής ο Απόστολος», with the rank word and the title left off.

Read out of the Ohrid Prologue's first heading for the Julian 8 April on pravoslavno.rs, „Св. апостоли Иродион, Агав, Руф, Асинкрит, Флегонт и Ермије.“, where Св. апостоли heads the whole company of six and belongs to no one of them, so each forename stands bare. The heading's form is Ермије and the body's is Ермија; the heading's is the one stored, as the quoted line is the heading. Dalmatia is in the body and not in the heading, and this corpus keeps a see in `office`.

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding Julian day (19 September 2026).

feast.note: The day page for 8 aprilie carries him, and the shared troparion is headed for the six of 8 aprilie; but his own page gives different days — «prăznuirea lui se face la 8 martie și la 4 ianuarie, împreună cu cei 70 de Apostoli» — and does not name 8 aprilie at all. The disagreement between the day list and the saint's own page is left standing; 8 aprilie is recorded because that is the day the Romanian calendar prints him on.

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 8 aprilie — «Sfântul Apostol Ermis»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 8ης Μαρτίου — «Άγιος Ερμής ο Απόστολος»

attestations.note: The life page, https://www.saint.gr/1242/saint.aspx, has its own «Ημερομηνία Εορτής» of 8 Μαρτίου and «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή». Its whole notice is: «Τον Άγιο Ερμή αναφέρει ο απόστολος Παύλος στην προς Ρωμαίους επιστολή του (ιστ' 14). Κατά την παράδοση έγινε επίσκοπος Δαλματίας και απεβίωσε ειρηνικά. Στον Συναξαριστή Delehaye καλείται Έρμυλος. Στον δε Παρισινό Κώδικα 13 φ. 296 η μνήμη του φέρεται κατά την 8η Απριλίου μετά του Ηρωδίωνος, Ασύγκριτου, Φλέγοντος, Ρούφου, Επαφρά και Αγάβου.» Romans 16:14 and the tradition of the see of Dalmatia are what identify him as this folder's man. The page names two complications and neither is acted on: that Delehaye's synaxarist calls him Έρμυλος — the corpus keeps a Hermylus, the deacon of Singidunum, whom saint.gr itself keeps on 13 Ιανουαρίου, and he is another man; and that the Parisian Codex 13 fol. 296 puts his memory on 8 April with Herodion, Asyncritus, Phlegon, Rufus, Epaphras and Agabus, which is the very company and the very day this folder's Romanian row already records. The Greek row therefore records 8 Μαρτίου, the day page read, and the codex's 8 April stands as the page's own second day. There is no year and no hymn.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 21.04.2026 (8. април ст. ст.) — „Св. апостоли Иродион, Агав, Руф, Асинкрит, Флегонт и Ермије.“

attestations.note: Sixth of the six the day's first heading enumerates. **The Prologue keeps him on the Romanian calendar's day and not the Greek one**: doxologia has him on 8 April with the rest of the company and saint.gr on 8 March, and the Prologue's menologion 8 April is the Romanian's number. One row per church, so the Greek row keeps its own day and nothing was moved. The man is the same beyond doubt: of the Seventy, mentioned with the others by Paul, and bishop in Dalmatia, which is this folder's own see and display name and agrees with both other calendars. The entry adds nothing else about him. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion.

hymns.text: Sfinţilor Apostoli rugaţi pe Milostivul Dumnezeu, ca să dea iertare de greşeli sufletelor noastre.

source.text: Doxologia — Troparul Sfinţilor Apostoli Irodion, Agav, Ruf, Flegon, Asincrit şi Ermis, Glasul 3

english.text: O holy apostles, pray the merciful God to grant our souls forgiveness of sins.
